title: JSON Schema for an Office Add-in Action File
description: A file describing the data format for a single Office.js action referenced by an Office Add-in's actionFile property.

$schema.title: ActionSchema
$schema.description: The URI/URL of this schema, which should always be https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/office-js/1.0/action.schema.json in a production app

id.title: Action ID
id.description: The ID of the action, which must match an action ID in the manifest.

description.title: Description
description.description: Describes what the action does and when to use it.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: The parameters that can be passed to the action. Mirrors the shape of an MCP tool inputSchema (a JSON Schema object), but supports only a subset of JSON Schema keywords.

type.title: Type
type.description: The JSON Schema type. Must be 'object'.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Maps parameter names to their definitions.

required.title: Required
required.description: The names of the required parameters. Each name must match a key in 'properties'.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Whether parameters not listed in 'properties' are allowed.

enum.title: Enum
enum.description: The valid values for this parameter. Only valid when 'type' is 'string'.

default.title: Default
default.description: The default value for an optional parameter. Must match the type specified by 'type'.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: The value returned by the action.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the returned value.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of the returned value.
